build_BaseShapeHead: build a BaseShapeHead with shared conv layers for 3D object classification and regression
build_ShapeAwareHead: build a ShapeAwareHead with multi-task anchor groups for shape-aware 3D detection
run_BaseShapeHead_forward: run the BaseShapeHead forward pass to get cls scores, bbox preds, and direction preds
run_ShapeAwareHead_loss: run the ShapeAwareHead loss calculation with ground truth bboxes and labels
run_ShapeAwareHead_get_bboxes: run get_bboxes on ShapeAwareHead to decode predictions and apply 3D NMS
